messages.body:
Dear Selin,

Thank you for considering me for the AI Engineer position at NeuralCore Labs and for the invitation to proceed to the next stage of the hiring process. I am excited about the opportunity to further discuss my background and contributions in machine learning and AI systems.

After reviewing the proposed time slots, I would like to confirm my availability for the interview. My preferred time slot is 17:30. If there are any additional details or requirements for the session via Google Meet, please let me know.

Thank you once again for this opportunity, and I look forward to your confirmation.

Best regards,


Mert Arcan
